description.value: Pita Pit is a national fast-casual chain specializing in freshly made pitas, salads, and rice bowls built to order from a wide range of ingredients. This Abbotsford location also offers smoothies and desserts on-site, along with takeout and delivery options. Cyclists passing through Abbotsford's Livingstone Avenue corridor can stop for a customizable, filling meal with catering available for larger groups.
